title: Could Thinking Multilingually Empower LLM Reasoning?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM reasoning accuracy on translated datasets (GPQA and MGSM) across 17 languages, and analyzing the selection frequencies of different languages in prompt-based answer selection and LLM-as-a-judge evaluations to identify preferences for English or high-resource languages over low-resource ones, regardless of answer correctness.
